dog.description_text:
Meet Chamomile, a 2 year old, 10 pound, wonderful Chihuahua/Yorkie mix. Although she is small, Chamomile is full of energy and ready for any adventure that awaits her! She is great with both dogs and cats, and is generally curious and independent.

Chamomile enjoys walks, snuggling on the couch, and getting belly rubs as she drifts off for her midday naps. She's not fussy with her food, is treat- and praise-motivated, and is well-adjusted for a home environment.

Apply to adopt this sweet girl today by visiting www.pupstarzrescue.org and filling out an application!
